mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.LOGIN_ID, M.NAME, M.EMAIL, M.PHONE, M.MEMBER_TYPE, M.STATUS, M.CREATED_AT, M.UPDATED_AT, M.WITHDRAWN_AT, L.LAWYER_ID FROM TB_MEMBER M LEFT JOIN TB_LAWYER L ON M.MEMBER_ID = L.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.LOGIN_ID, M.PASSWORD, M.MEMBER_TYPE, M.NAME, REPLACE(M.PHONE, '-', '') AS PHONE, M.EMAIL, M.PROVIDER, M.PHONE_VERIFIED, M.STATUS, M.SAVE_ID_YN, M.ADDRESS, M.DETAIL_ADDR, M.CREATED_AT, M.UPDATED_AT, M.WITHDRAWN_AT, L.LAWYER_ID, L.LICENSE_NO, L.SPECIALTY, L.OFFICE_ADDR, L.OFFICE_DETAIL_ADDR FROM TB_MEMBER M LEFT JOIN TB_LAWYER L ON M.MEMBER_ID = L.MEMBER_ID WHERE M.EMAIL = #{email}

choose.when: SELECT q.QUESTION_ID as "id", q.TITLE as "title", TO_CHAR(q.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "date", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ANSWER WHERE QUESTION_ID = q.QUESTION_ID) as "commentCount", CASE WHEN q.STATUS = 'CLOSED' THEN '답변완료' ELSE '대기중' END as "status" FROM TB_QUESTION q WHERE q.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY q.QUESTION_ID DESC

SELECT p.POLL_ID as "id", c.TITLE as "title", TO_CHAR(c.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "date", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMMENT WHERE POST_ID = c.POST_ID) as "commentCount", CASE WHEN c.STATUS = 'CLOSED' THEN '투표종료' ELSE '진행중' END as "status" FROM TB_POST c JOIN TB_POLL p ON c.POST_ID = p.POST_ID WHERE c.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND c.CASE_TYPE = 'POLL' ORDER BY p.POLL_ID DESC

SELECT c.POST_ID as "id", c.TITLE as "title", TO_CHAR(c.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "date", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMMENT WHERE POST_ID = c.POST_ID) as "commentCount" FROM TB_POST c WHERE c.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND c.CASE_TYPE = '자유' ORDER BY c.POST_ID DESC
